chat2_only.why: knows only chat 2: the docstring's subject or body, and the first team in KEYWORDS order wins

chat1_only.why: knows only chat 1: priority 1 tickets are routed to the teams like any other

reads_body.why: follows the docstring and matches words in the body as well as the subject

most_words.why: gives a ticket that matches several teams to the team with the most words in the subject

on_call_hyphen.why: sends priority 1 to an on-call queue spelled on-call, not oncall
